title: carex foenea var. aenea
intro: Carex foenea var. aenea, commonly known as Yellow Sedge, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Sedge are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce swelling, and promote tissue repair, making it a potential treatment for conditions like sprains and bruises. The bioactive constituents of Carex foenea var. aenea include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
